mapper.select: select id,username,password_hash,display_name,department_id,enabled from sys_user where username=#{username} and deleted=0
select id,username,display_name,department_id from sys_user where id=#{id} and enabled=1 and deleted=0
select r.code from sys_role r join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id=r.id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.deleted=0 and r.enabled=1

select distinct p.code from sys_permission p join sys_role_permission rp on rp.permission_id=p.id join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id=rp.role_id join sys_role r on r.id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.deleted=0 and r.enabled=1
